description: Raw model outputs replayed through the production createDreamingExtractor (apps/worker/src/memory-dreaming.ts) via a fake AI binding. expected_kept = how many candidates a careful reviewer would expect to survive parsing, i.e. the number of well-formed, valid facts present in the raw text. Covers formats small instruct models commonly produce (code fences, preambles, trailing notes, trailing commas, wrapper objects) and short CJK facts that hit the 8-character minimum.
